body:
Hey @ianfortier, we are definitely working on making InstantSearch v4 available here, however the server side rendering with multiple indices is proving to be quite the challenge to find an API which doesn't require users to duplicate their widget tree.

Once we have that we can release.

If you're not using server side rendering, you can use 3.0.0-beta.0 of Vue InstantSearch, which includes InstantSearch v4
